summary: DENTSPLY SIRONA filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026 disclosing lender consents and amendments to its financing arrangements: a Third Amendment to its May 12, 2023 revolving credit facility with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent, plus Note Purchase Agreement Amendments No. 5 across three private placement note agreements (2015, 2016 and 2019). The amendments raise maximum Total and Senior Leverage Ratio covenants for the quarters ending September 30 and December 31, 2026, permit an added EBITDA addback for certain cash charges, and until the FY2026 compliance certificate generally bar new liens and subsidiary debt while limiting restricted payments, with added quarterly reporting. No securities transaction, stakeholder action or strategic event is involved.
